```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a count plot for survival based on class and sex
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.countplot(data=data, x='pclass', hue='sex', palette='muted')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Survival Count by Class and Sex on the Titanic', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Count of Passengers', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Sex', fontsize=12)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
